properties.NAME: British West Florida
properties.CHANGE: By royal proclamation King George III organized former Spanish Florida into the new British colonies of East and West Florida. The boundary between East and West Florida was the Apalachicola River.
properties.CITATION: (Cappon, Petchenik, and Long, 1, 77; Shortt and Doughty, 119-120; Van Zandt, 103)
